content.title: Martin Marietta Materials (NYSE:MLM) Misses Q3 CY2025 Revenue Estimates
content.summary: Construction materials supplier Martin Marietta Materials (NYSE:MLM) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, but sales rose 12.4% year on year to $1.85 billion. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $6.16 billion at the midpoint came in 11.7% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $6.85 per share was 2.5% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
